# Global Sovereign University

> Global Sovereign University (GSU) is a tuition-free educational platform operated by The Foundation for Global Instruction, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Eugene, Oregon (EIN 39-2716552). Founded by Dr. Gene A. Constant, a US Navy and Marine Corps veteran and author of more than 270 published titles, all donated to the university. There is no signup, no advertising, and no paywall. GENO, the GSU AI tutor, is available 24/7 in 83 languages — a robot you can actually TALK to — serving as a comprehension coach for everything taught on campus. Mission: Pupils before Profits — free education for all.

## How GSU Works (honest framing)

- The GSU Library at https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/library is a storefront: each book is shown with its cover and a link to its $3.99 Kindle edition on Amazon. Kindle royalties are the Foundation's revenue and fund the free mission.
- Books featured on GSU subject hubs and reader pages ARE readable free in full on the site, and the free audiobook app reads them aloud.
- GENO's role is comprehension support — a resort for comprehension. He has memorized the full text of the books in his knowledge base and can discuss, quiz, and explain them in any of his 83 languages.
- Every comprehension exam is a real bar: honest failure feedback, specific remedial guidance, and serial-numbered certificates that are earned, never given.

## About the Foundation

- [Mission](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/mission): Pedagogical philosophy and the case for free sovereign education.
- [Three Pillars](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/three-pillars): Sovereign Intelligence, Sovereign Skills, Sovereign Character.
- [The Honest Transcript](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/honest-transcript): A verified record of demonstrated competence.
- [Civilization Builders](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/civilization-builders): Retired professionals mentoring learners worldwide.
- [The Sovereign Handshake](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/sovereign-handshake): The single intake form matching learners and volunteer tutors.

## Main Campus Subject Hubs

- [Readification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/readification): Reading education on the Reading Helix framework — Five Pillars, phonics games, oral fluency tools.
- [Mathification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/mathification): Mathematics from arithmetic through algebra and geometry.
- [Spellification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/spellification): Spelling and orthography.
- [Writification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/writification): Writing craft.
- [Civics](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/civics): American civics and citizenship.
- [Science](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/science): General science education.
- [History of Americans](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/history-of-americans): American history.
- [Geography](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/geography): World geography.
- [Lawification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/lawification): Law for everyday life.
- [Wealthification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/wealthification): Personal finance and economic sovereignty.
- [Entrepreneurship](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/entrepreneurship): Building and running a business.
- [Tradification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/tradification): The skilled trades — with dedicated hubs including [HVAC](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/hvac-trade).
- [Thinkification](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/thinkification): Critical thinking and logic.
- [The Library](https://globalsovereignuniversity.org/library): The complete GSU catalog storefront — 300+ titles, $3.99 Kindle editions that fund the free mission.

## The Reading Room (this subdomain)

- [Reading Room Directory](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html): Every certification, game, instrument, and reader on this subdomain, on one page.
- [Free Comprehension Certifications](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#certs): 24 subjects with serial-numbered certificates — including Readification, Mathification, Science, Civics, American History, Geography, Lawification, Spellification, HVAC, Tradification, Entrepreneurship, Economics, First Aid, Computer Literacy, and more.
- [The Learning Arcade](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/learning-arcade.html): Games built from GSU books — climbs, forges, simulators, and tribunals that turn knowledge into skill.
- [Free Instruments](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#tools): The Oral Reading Fluency analyzer, Where Do I Stand diagnostic, Adult Literacy Lab, and more.
- [Readers & Roads](https://read.globalsovereignuniversity.org/directory.html#roads): Full free reading experiences including the World Climb reader, the Barter workshop, and the Trifurcation Road.
